sections.Profile:
Based on the monumental work The 3 Musketeers by Alexandre Dumas, this pinball game plunges you into the adventure of d'Artagnan, an ambitious young Gascon who dreams of joining the prestigious Musketeers serving King Louis XIII of France. Along the way, you will encounter his legendary companions Athos, Porthos and Aramis, as well as the mysterious and dangerous Milady de Winter, who operates in the shadows under the orders of the powerful Cardinal Richelieu. Duels, intrigue, and conspiracies forge this perilous adventure, where every move on the playfield can decide the fate of the Musketeers.
